tool_schemas.name: Optional Settings
tool_schemas.description: Creates or resumes an authenticated session scoped to the provided organization (and optionally a specific server) so you can enumerate and manage CData Connect Cloud servers and their connections; returns the session tokens and metadata (access_token, refresh_token, expires_at, status) when successful. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when any provided id does not match its required format, when mutually exclusive identity inputs are provided (e.g., both user_id and api_client_id), or when status/expires_at are inconsistent with an active session. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not permitted to sign in or the provided tokens are invalid/expired/revoked, FORBIDDEN when the identity is not a member of the organization or lacks server-management permissions, NOT_FOUND when organization_id or selected_server_id does not exist or is not visible to the caller, and CONFLICT when attempting to create or use a session that is revoked or otherwise not eligible for activation.

organization_id.description: Organization id to sign in to and scope server management.

user_id.description: User id to create an authenticated session for.

api_client_id.description: API client id to create an authenticated session for (service-to-service sign-in).

selected_server_id.description: Server id to select for the session to use when enumerating/managing connections.

access_token.description: Access token for the active authenticated session.

refresh_token.description: Refresh token for the authenticated session.

expires_at.description: Expiration timestamp for the access token/session.

ip_address.description: IP address to associate with the session.

user_agent.description: User agent string to associate with the session.

tool_schemas.name: Organizations
tool_schemas.description: Lists organizations the caller is entitled to access. Returns a paginated array of organizations. Refuses with AUTH_REQUIRED when the access_token is missing/invalid/expired, and with FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks scope to enumerate organizations.

access_token.description: Bearer access token for the active authenticated session.

region.description: Filter by organization region (vendor region code).

limit.description: Maximum number of organizations to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: Servers
tool_schemas.description: Lists servers within an organization. Returns a paginated array of servers the caller can manage. Refuses with AUTH_REQUIRED when the access_token is missing/invalid/expired, VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed ids, and FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot access the organization.

access_token.description: Bearer access token for the active authenticated session.

organization_id.description: Organization id to list servers for.

limit.description: Maximum number of servers to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: Update Server
tool_schemas.description: Updates a server's mutable fields (name, selected settings) and/or drives allowed lifecycle transitions via status. Returns the updated server record. Refuses with AUTH_REQUIRED when the access_token is missing/invalid/expired, VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed ids/invalid settings, CONFLICT when a unique constraint would be violated (e.g., base_url within the organization), and FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot manage the server.

access_token.description: Bearer access token for the active authenticated session.

name.description: New display name for the server.

base_url.description: New base URL for the server; must be unique within the organization.

settings.description: Server settings blob; keys are product-defined. Unknown keys may be rejected.

status.description: Requested lifecycle transition. Only valid transitions are accepted (e.g., online->offline, offline->online, *->deleted).

tool_schemas.name: Create API Client
tool_schemas.description: Creates an API client credential within an organization for service-to-service authentication. Returns the created api_client including its client_key and a one-time client_secret (only returned on creation). Refuses with AUTH_REQUIRED when the access_token is missing/invalid/expired, VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed ids/invalid scopes, and FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks permission to create API clients.

access_token.description: Bearer access token for the active authenticated session.

organization_id.description: Organization id to create the API client in.

tool_schemas.name: Update API Client
tool_schemas.description: Updates an API client's mutable fields and drives lifecycle transitions (active<->revoked, or deleted). Returns the updated api_client. If transitioning to revoked, all active auth sessions for this api_client are revoked in the same operation. Refuses with AUTH_REQUIRED when the access_token is missing/invalid/expired, VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed ids/invalid scopes, and FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks permission.

access_token.description: Bearer access token for the active authenticated session.

scopes.description: Replacement scope set for the client.

status.description: Requested lifecycle transition. Only valid transitions are accepted.

tool_schemas.name: Who Am I
tool_schemas.description: Returns the current authenticated principal and session context, including principal type (user or api_client), organization entitlement, effective scopes, and current quota/rate-limit consumption. Refuses with AUTH_REQUIRED when the access_token is missing/invalid/expired or the session is revoked.

access_token.description: Bearer access token for the active authenticated session.

metadata.name: CData Connect Cloud MCP Server
metadata.description: This backend stores identities, organizations, and authenticated sessions for accessing and managing CData Connect Cloud servers. The primary workflow is a user/agent signs in to an organization, receives a session, and uses that session to enumerate and manage server connections and related setting
